events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit ancestry, guide file status, audit rows and probe scripts
events.input: $ git fetch --dry-run 2>&1 | head -3; git merge-base --is-ancestor cf3d5ff origin/main && echo ANCESTOR_OK; git merge-base --is-ancestor b880b67 origin/main && echo B880_OK; git rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main; git status --short -- app/src/content/guides cloud/src/pack-followups.ts cloud/src/pack.ts | head; echo ---; git log --oneline -8 -- app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline app/src/content/guides/s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts cloud/src/pack-followups.ts; echo ---; grep -nE "X090|X102|X103|X104|X105|G070" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-80,200-700 | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: List the key lines in the four edited guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/src/content/guides && wc -l s5-pipeline/s5-crm-starter.ts s5-pipeline/s5-extra-pipelines.ts s5-pipeline/s5-follow-ups.ts s5-pipeline/s5-challenge-stages.ts s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts ../../../../cloud/src/pack-followups.ts; echo; grep -nE "auto|crm-setup|d2-reminders|event-attendance|attended-day|deploy-funnel|follow-ups/|prompts?:|label:|title:" s5-pipeline/s5-extra-pipelines.ts s5-pipeline/s5-follow-ups.ts s5-pipeline/s5-challenge-stages.ts s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run check-guides and inspect how the probes are invoked
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git rev-parse --short HEAD; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline | wc -l; cd app && (node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6); sed -n 1,40p scripts/probe-guides.mjs | cut -c1-220; grep -nE "process\.(argv|env)\.[A-Z_]*|argv" scripts/probe-flows.mjs | head -12; lsof -iTCP:4399 -sTCP:LISTEN -P | tail -1
